levels.DECISION_CHANGED_EXECUTION: perturbing the decision changes the delivered request/stage
levels.ENGINE_CONSUMER_PERTURBED: perturbing the input changes the consumer output
levels.REAL_ARTISTIC_FIDELITY: provider pixels + human review: none exist (ZERO)

rows.title: F01 — Silhouette and functional anatomy (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: subject has a drawn physical silhouette

rows.title: F02 — Surface-color construction instead of generic line art (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: every illustrated surface is built from owned colour regions

rows.title: F03 — Conditional color-role solver (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: every new image needs conditional colour roles

rows.title: F04 — Four distinct lighting systems (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: lit surfaces need a lighting system choice

rows.title: F05 — Human head and facial-state fabrication (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: a human face is visible

rows.title: F06 — Human body, hands, locomotion and meaningful contacts (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: a human body acts, locomotes or contacts

rows.title: F07 — Distinct mascot and animal construction (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: an animal/mascot/organism is constructed

rows.title: F08 — Architecture and oblique projection (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: architecture / built structure is present

rows.title: F09 — Machines and functional apparatus (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: a machine or functional apparatus is present

rows.title: F10 — Complete spaces and foreground/background integration (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: a complete space with foreground/background integration

rows.title: F11 — Landscape, plant and environmental density (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: landscape/plant/environmental density is present

rows.title: F12 — Designed dense biological network (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: a dense biological network is present

rows.title: F13 — Structural luminous, optical and complex materials (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: luminous, optical or complex materials are present

rows.title: F14 — Illustrated transformation and alternate state design (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: the subject has alternate states

rows.title: F15 — Motion ownership, simultaneous choreography, camera (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: the subject is owned by motion tracks

rows.title: F16 — Transitions as complete illustrations plus masks (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: a transition involves the subject's shots

rows.title: F17 — Whole-look and provider-control proof (T, I)
rows.applicability_rule: every artwork needs whole-look / provider-control proof

rows.title: F18 — Every-frame observation without confusing it with decoding
rows.applicability_rule: every frame is observed, not decoded

rows.title: F19 — Production medium and timing are conditional, not a universal vector-only preset (O, I)
rows.applicability_rule: medium and timing are routed per subject

rows.title: F20 — Route *each beat* to a visual medium; permit nesting
rows.applicability_rule: each beat is routed to a medium

rows.title: F21 — A panel, glass shell or memory window is a layered optical *machine*
rows.applicability_rule: a panel/glass shell/memory window acts as an optical machine

rows.title: F22 — Rebuild day/night as registered drawings, not a color-grade
rows.applicability_rule: day/night states are redrawn

rows.title: F23 — Define *perception effects* as registered compositing passes
rows.applicability_rule: perception effects are registered compositing passes

rows.title: F24 — Dense biological fields are procedurally authored, *not random scatter*
rows.applicability_rule: a dense biological field is present

rows.title: F25 — Scientific close-ups must encode physical interaction *direction*
rows.applicability_rule: a scientific close-up shows physical interaction direction

rows.title: F26 — Maps and spatial diagrams need *three distinct masks*
rows.applicability_rule: a map or spatial diagram is present

rows.title: F27 — Schematic graphs are authored *systems with reveal states*
rows.applicability_rule: a schematic graph with reveal states is present

rows.title: F28 — Historical or technical recreations have *era-specific mechanical topology*
rows.applicability_rule: a historical/technical recreation is present

rows.title: F29 — Compare futures/options as complete *parallel states*
rows.applicability_rule: futures/options are compared as parallel states

rows.title: F30 — Create a multi-state character library before physical animation
rows.applicability_rule: a character/organism needs a multi-state library

rows.title: F31 — Motion needs *owner-specific* key states, not global ease-only language
rows.applicability_rule: motion keys are owner-specific

rows.title: F32 — Effects are time-bounded images with their own color/geometry ownership
rows.applicability_rule: time-bounded effects are present

rows.title: F33 — Density and abstraction are scoped by *view depth and task*, not adjective
rows.applicability_rule: density/abstraction is scoped by view depth and task

rows.title: F34 — Physical geography, procedural patterns and materials use different generators
rows.applicability_rule: geography/patterns/materials need different generators

rows.title: F35 — Make storyboard *transitions* carry one conserved visual invariant
rows.applicability_rule: storyboard transitions carry one conserved invariant

rows.title: F36 — Source-to-new-script skill must compile into enforceable artifacts
rows.applicability_rule: source-to-new-script decisions compile into enforceable artifacts

evidence.note: preGenerationGate refuses/accepts by decision content (U01/U03, S3C-1..9)

rows.title: F37 — Construct a *world definition*, not an adjective or a backdrop
rows.applicability_rule: a world definition is required

rows.title: F38 — Pick a *projection grammar* and enforce it down to small parts
rows.applicability_rule: depth, scale levels, repeats or floating planes need a projection grammar

rows.title: F39 — Build *living natural environments* from functional, occluding plant systems
rows.applicability_rule: a living natural environment is built

rows.title: F40 — Build *dense architectural/ecological worlds* with modular part budgets
rows.applicability_rule: a dense architectural/ecological world with modular parts

rows.title: F41 — Create biological *micro-worlds* from parent anatomy and networks
rows.applicability_rule: a biological micro-world is built

rows.title: F42 — Construct an *abstract stage* from legible spatial coordinates
rows.applicability_rule: an abstract stage with legible coordinates

rows.title: F43 — Construct an *information theatre* rather than flat UI wallpaper
rows.applicability_rule: an information theatre is built

rows.title: F44 — A luminous *volume* requires faces, apertures, sockets and optical layers
rows.applicability_rule: a luminous volume is present

rows.title: F45 — Construct machines and futuristic corridors by *functional topology first*
rows.applicability_rule: machines/corridors by functional topology

rows.title: F46 — Use *material-owning* edges, fills and luminance: no universal glow or outline
rows.applicability_rule: a scene/environment needs material-owned edges, fills and luminance

rows.title: F47 — Spend *detail* according to semantic role and visual distance
rows.applicability_rule: a detailed environment spends detail by semantic role and distance

rows.title: F48 — Represent a *world within a world* as two complete constructions
rows.applicability_rule: a world within a world is shown

rows.title: F49 — Compile *world construction data* into an enforceable ArtJob
rows.applicability_rule: world construction data compiles into an enforceable ArtJob

rows.title: F50 — Run adversarial *unfamiliar-world* transfer tests; do not certify by resemblance to one film frame
rows.applicability_rule: unfamiliar-world transfer tests

rows.title: F51 — Palette is a system of roles and region ownership, not one studio-wide swatch set
rows.applicability_rule: palette is a system of roles and region ownership

rows.title: F52 — Scale and semantic role determine the number of facial/structural marks
rows.applicability_rule: scale and role determine facial/structural mark count

rows.title: F53 — Density is caused by explanatory material, not by a desire to impress
rows.applicability_rule: density is caused by explanatory material

rows.title: F54 — Repeated shapes require a parent-owned generator
rows.applicability_rule: repeated shapes need a parent-owned generator

rows.title: F55 — The new idea determines the world projection and the camera-sized artwork
rows.applicability_rule: projection and camera-sized artwork follow the idea

rows.title: F56 — Execute source-grounded prompts as geometry, then inspect first pixels
rows.applicability_rule: prompts execute as geometry; first pixels are inspected

rows.title: F57 — Start with a visible causal proof, not a “beautiful scene”
rows.applicability_rule: a visible causal proof is required

rows.title: F58 — Construct the silhouette before interior polish
rows.applicability_rule: silhouette is constructed before interior polish

rows.title: F59 — Parts must join and occlude in a deliberate topology
rows.applicability_rule: parts join and occlude in a deliberate topology

rows.title: F60 — Choose projection from the proof and make all planes obey it
rows.applicability_rule: projection is chosen from the proof and all planes obey it

rows.title: F61 — Invent conditional palette **roles**, never imitate a universal swatch palette
rows.applicability_rule: conditional palette roles

rows.title: F62 — Edges and shadows have owners; universal black outlines and bevels do not
rows.applicability_rule: edges and shadows have owners

rows.title: F63 — Keep reflection, transparency, blur, glow and grain inside physical optics
rows.applicability_rule: reflection/transparency/blur/glow stays inside physical optics

rows.title: F64 — Human/mascot/animal identity must be routed by *illustration family*
rows.applicability_rule: human/mascot/animal identity routed by illustration family

rows.title: F65 — Eye and mouth construction depends on the **role** and crop
rows.applicability_rule: eye/mouth construction depends on role and crop

rows.title: F66 — Body acting needs weight, garment volumes and contact states
rows.applicability_rule: body acting needs weight, garment volumes and contact states

rows.title: F67 — Expression and pose animation is a *registered state family*
rows.applicability_rule: pose/expression/mechanism states form a registered family

rows.title: F68 — Machines are part-defined functional volumes, not neon rectangles
rows.applicability_rule: machines are part-defined functional volumes

rows.title: F69 — Landscapes are *coverage substrates* with selective living detail
rows.applicability_rule: landscapes are coverage substrates

rows.title: F70 — Built worlds use coherent projection and semantic architectural repetition
rows.applicability_rule: built worlds use coherent projection and semantic repetition

rows.title: F71 — Dense microscopic biology is a connected graph, not a particle wallpaper
rows.applicability_rule: dense microscopic biology is a connected graph

rows.title: F72 — Macro organisms and lenses are distinct coordinate systems
rows.applicability_rule: macro organisms and lenses are distinct coordinate systems

rows.title: F73 — Cosmic/scale worlds depend on physical and diagrammatic meaning
rows.applicability_rule: cosmic/scale worlds depend on physical meaning

rows.title: F74 — Abstract information worlds need a visible representational grammar
rows.applicability_rule: abstract information worlds need a representational grammar

rows.title: F75 — Typography and diagram glyphs are specific illustration parts
rows.applicability_rule: typography and glyphs are illustration parts

rows.title: F76 — Repeats should come from a locally defined parent generator
rows.applicability_rule: repeats come from a locally defined parent generator

rows.title: F77 — Information density must be allocated *locally* and to motion owners
rows.applicability_rule: information density is allocated locally and to motion owners

rows.title: F78 — Camera and representational transitions must obey a correspondence invariant
rows.applicability_rule: camera/representational transitions obey a correspondence invariant

rows.title: F79 — Own the alpha, underpaint, parallax and offscreen drawing budget
rows.applicability_rule: alpha, underpaint, parallax and offscreen budget are owned

rows.applicability_rule: the first provider request contains the methods and unlike native pixels
